text: ここまで　きたのは　ほめるが　しゃちょう　しつは　さらに　うえの　かい　だぜ

structure.jp: ここまで　きたのは
structure.en: the fact that you came this far

structure.jp: しゃちょう　しつは
さらに　うえの　かい　だぜ
structure.en: is on an even higher floor

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の wraps up everything before it into one thing you can talk about, like 'the fact that'. ここまで きたのは = 'that you came this far'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が after a full statement means 'but'. ほめるが = 'I'll praise it, but'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes the statement at the listener. うえの かい だぜ = 'it's a higher floor, pal'.
